# Draft:Traditional names of places in Anatolia

A number of place names in Anatolia changed over history, some during the Byzantine period like Chrysopolis / Scoutarion, and others during the Turcocracy like Kydonies / Ayvalık.
{| class="wikitable sortable" style=text-align:top;
!Original name|| Traditional region || History || Present appellation
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Ancyra, || Galatia || Ἄγκυρα / Ánkyra  Angora (after 1073) || Ankara
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Chalcedon || Bithynia || Χαλκηδών / Khalkēdṓn  Jurisdiction of the Constantinople courts || Kadıköy, "Village of the Judge" (after 1353)  (south-east of Constantinople across Bosphorus)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Chrysopolis || Bithynia || Χρυσόπολις / Khrusópolis, 'Golden City'  Σκουτάριον / Skoutarion during the Byzantine Empire || Üsküdar (after 1338)  (east of Constantinople across the Bosphorus)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Heraclea Pontica || Bithynia ||  Ἡράκλεια Ποντική / Hērákleia Pontikḗ || Ereğli / Karadeniz Ereğli
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Girê Mirazan || Syria ||  || Göbekli Tepe
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Hierapolis || Bithynia ||  Ἡράκλεια Ποντική / Hērákleia Pontikḗ || Pamukkale
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Kydonies || Aeolis || Κυδωνίες || Ayvalık
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Nicaea || Bithynia ||  / Níkaia || İznik (after 1331)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Nicomedia || Bithynia || Νικομήδεια / Nikomḗdeia  Isnikmid (English usage) || İzmit (after 1337)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Pergamus || Aeolis || Πέργαμον / Pérgamon  Πέργαμος / Pérgamos || Bergama (after 1302)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Prusa || Bithynia || Προῦσα / Proûsa  Brusa, Brussa, Brousa, Broussa || Bursa (after 1326)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Sangarius (river) || Bithynia || Σαγγάριος / Sangários  Sangaris, Sagaris || Sakarya River
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Smyrna || Lydia || Μύρρᾱ / Múrrhā (Aeolic)  Σμύρνη / Smýrnē (Ionic), Σμύρνα / Smýrna || İzmir (after 1402)
|- style=vertical-align:top
| Trebizond || Pontus || Τραπεζοῦς / Trapezoûs  Τραπεζούντα / Trapezounta || Trabzon
|}
